info.body_text:
Emily stepped into the English classroom, the familiar scent of chalk and old books filling the air. The soft murmur of students chatting died down as the teacher entered from the other side.

She slid into her seat near the window, right beside Sarah, who greeted her with a mischievous grin.

"Welcome back, world traveler," Sarah whispered, nudging her playfully. "So? You ready to stir up some chaos again or what?"

"What do you mean?" Emily raised an eyebrow.

"I dare you..." </s> Sarah leaned in. "Stick your leg out in the aisle. When the teacher walks by, she’ll trip.Let's see what panties is she wearing today"

Emily blinked, unsure if Sarah was joking—or serious. The teacher was already beginning to pace around with her lesson book in hand.


Stay focused and study


Do what Sarah suggested
